intro.title: What does Exyconn build for salons, spas and wellness businesses?
intro.definition: is a set of agents that take bookings, send reminders, keep client notes, sell packages and gather reviews, so stylists and therapists keep their hands on clients instead of on the phone. Exyconn designs, builds and runs these agents on your salon software, WhatsApp Business account and Instagram. Your front desk still decides on exceptions, refunds and anything a client is unhappy about.

benefits.title: Why salons and spas are doing this now

items.text: Clients decide to book a haircut late at night, scrolling Instagram, not during opening hours.
A no-show on a two-hour colour appointment is lost time that can't be sold again.
Stylists answering the phone mid-service means wet hair, waiting clients and missed calls.
Memberships and packages bring clients back, but only if someone tracks and renews them.
New clients choose a salon from photos and reviews on Google and Instagram.

props.label: The reality
props.title: Where a salon's hours actually go
props.lede: Spend a Saturday behind a salon's front desk and the pressure points are easy to spot.

items.title: Booking by phone tag
items.text: Clients call, DM on Instagram and message on WhatsApp to ask for slots. The person who answers has to check three stylists' diaries while the client waits.

items.title: No-shows and late cancellations
items.text: A missed bridal trial or a long colour booking leaves a stylist idle for hours. Taking deposits fairly and consistently is awkward to do by hand.

items.title: Client history in someone's head
items.text: The colour formula, the preferred therapist, a skin sensitivity or an allergy is remembered by one person. When that stylist leaves, the knowledge goes with her.

items.title: Packages nobody tracks
items.text: Prepaid packages and memberships are sold at the counter and then tracked on paper or memory. Sessions expire unused, and renewals are never offered.

items.title: Before-and-after photos never posted
items.text: Happy clients leave without being asked for a review, and great results stay on stylists' phones instead of the salon's Google profile.

items.title: Who's busy and who isn't
items.text: Some chairs are booked weeks ahead while others sit empty on weekdays. Commission, retail sales and rebooking rates are worked out by hand at month-end.

offerings.title: Six jobs AI takes off your front desk

items.title: Bookings at any hour
items.text: Books, moves and cancels appointments from WhatsApp, Instagram and your website against each stylist's live diary in your salon software, allowing for service length and processing time.

items.title: Reminders and fewer no-shows
items.text: Sends confirmations and reminders with prep notes such as a patch test, collects deposits for long or high-value services under your policy, and offers freed slots to the waitlist.

items.title: Client preferences and history
items.text: Keeps each client's preferred stylist, colour formula, allergies and past services on their profile and puts them in front of the stylist before the appointment.

items.title: Memberships and packages
items.text: Tracks sessions left and expiry dates, tells clients their balance when they book, and offers a renewal or a suitable package when one is about to run out.

items.title: Reviews and photos
items.text: Asks happy clients for a Google review after their visit, collects before-and-after photos with their consent for your Instagram, and drafts replies to reviews for the manager to approve.

items.title: Stylist utilisation and revenue
items.text: Reports chair and room utilisation, revenue and rebooking by stylist, retail sales and commission from the salon software, with the quiet slots worth filling highlighted.

props.label: FAQ
props.title: Questions salon and spa owners ask us

items.question: Will this replace my receptionist?
items.answer: No. It takes the booking messages and reminders off the desk so your receptionist can welcome clients, sell retail and handle anyone who isn't happy. Exceptions, refunds and complaints always go to a person.

items.question: Does it work with my salon software?
items.answer: It works with salon and spa software that has an API or a dependable export, so it books into the same diary your team already uses. In the first week we confirm what your system allows the agent to read and change.

items.question: Can it take deposits to stop no-shows?
items.answer: Yes, if you want it to. You set the rules, for example a deposit for bridal trials or services over two hours, and the agent sends a payment link through your gateway. Refund decisions stay with the front desk.

items.question: Will it give skin or treatment advice?
items.answer: No. It shares the preparation and aftercare notes you've written and sends patch-test and consent forms. Questions about reactions, skin conditions or suitability go to your therapist or dermatologist.

items.question: What about client photos and personal data?
items.answer: Client details, notes and photos stay in your systems and a private environment we set up for you. Photos are posted only with the client's recorded consent, and marketing goes only to clients who opted in, in line with India's DPDP Act or the GDPR where it applies.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: It depends on the number of outlets, stylists and channels. Most salons start with bookings and reminders on WhatsApp; tell us about yours and we'll send a fixed quote for the first phase.
